messages:
marco: Noticed a weird one in canary: editors are seeing the 'danger zone' project delete button in the Console UI.
anya: Repro'd locally with editor token. Button visible but API returns 403 on delete. UI actually submits and shows a spinner then an error.
marco: Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/bugs/1767149999.png
ops-bot: deploy service:ui-frontend @ 1767149980 succeeded (sha:ef45c).
judy: Checked audit logs: multiple 403s for /api/projects/xyz/delete from editor accounts between 2026-03-20T14:02:00Z and 2026-03-20T14:06:00Z. No successful deletes.
anya: Log excerpt: `authz: checkPerms(user_id=U123, project=xyz) -> DENY (required: project.owner)`
marco: Hypothesis: frontend shipped an updated role->capability mapping (editor_v2) but role-resolver still had old aliasing. Client-side cache returned has_cap('project.delete')=true while server denies.
judy: Also saw intermittent KMS decrypt errors during same window: `AccessDeniedException for key alias/console-session` logged by session-service. Might've caused session refresh fallback which repopulated cached roles.
sec-oncall: Triage steps: 1) Pause further frontend canary, 2) Rollback frontend to previous stable, 3) Force invalidate client role cache via session endpoint, 4) Run replay to find affected users and emit audit CSV.
anya: I'll prepare a hotfix to query server for controls on mount rather than relying on bundled mapping. Small change: call `/api/v1/session/controls` that returns `{show_delete:false,...}`.
marco: Opened PR: https://git.redwood.ai/console/pulls/9999 - adds server-side control flags and backfill for client caches.
ops-bot: rollback started for cohort public (canary id 1767149980).
judy: Running `rbac-replay --start=2026-03-20T14:00:00Z --end=2026-03-20T14:10:00Z --out=s3://redwood-audit/rbac/mismatch-1767149999.csv`
sec-oncall: Also request KMS team to look into the decryptAccessDenied spikes; correlate with session-service deploys.
marco: Agreed. If any admin-scoped API returned 200 during the window, page sec-oncall immediately. So far audit shows 403 only.
anya: Will add temporary alert: metric `ui_control_show && api_response_403` > 5/min -> pager to eng-security.
judy: After rollback and cache invalidation, confirmed UI no longer shows delete button for editors in canary.
marco: Follow-ups: (A) Add a deployment ordering rule for role-mapping and UI mappings, (B) Add migration backfill with idempotent alias reconciliation, (C) Provide runbook for future client-server drift.
sec-oncall: Noted. Closing incident once backfill CSV is uploaded and KMS spikes explained.
